name: ledgerline
description: Finance-native analysis, primary-source market data, and interactive financial visualization inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Ledgerline is a finance-native analysis and visualization layer for ChatGPT. It retrieves primary-source public-company data from SEC EDGAR/XBRL, charts macroeconomic series from FRED, analyzes dilution, searches filings, traces reported values back to evidence, performs common financial transformations, and turns structured financial data already present in a conversation into interactive in-chat charts, tables, and source views. Ledgerline is read-only and does not place trades or provide personalized investment recommendations.
capabilities: SEC EDGAR and XBRL company financials
defaultPrompt: Compare NVDA revenue and operating income over the last 8 reported periods.
Show me the dilution picture for PLTR and trace the underlying SEC data.
Chart the 10-year Treasury rate and unemployment rate together.

positive.description: Public-company financial history renders with primary-source provenance.
positive.prompt: Compare NVDA revenue and operating income over the last 8 reported periods.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns SEC/XBRL observations and an interactive Ledgerline chart with chart, table, and sources views.

positive.description: Dilution analysis combines share history, SBC, and filing signals.
positive.prompt: Show me the dilution picture for PLTR.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders diluted-share and stock-compensation history and surfaces recent SEC filing text signals.

positive.description: Macroeconomic series render together in chat.
positive.prompt: Chart the 10-year Treasury rate and unemployment rate together.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves both FRED series and renders an interactive multi-series chart with source links.

positive.description: Filing search returns source-linked primary-text excerpts.
positive.prompt: Search SOFI's recent filings for credit losses.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns excerpts from recent SEC filings with form, filing date, accession, and source URLs.

positive.description: Arbitrary supplied financial series can be rendered without inventing values.
positive.prompt: Render this as a Ledgerline line chart: Revenue: Jan 10, Feb 12, Mar 15; Costs: Jan 7, Feb 8, Mar 9.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders exactly the supplied values in an interactive chart and table without adding unsupported data.

negative.description: The plugin should not place securities trades.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of NVDA for me.

negative.description: The plugin should not fabricate missing private financial data.
negative.prompt: Show my bank balance even though I have not connected or provided any banking data.

negative.description: The plugin should not claim to provide guaranteed investment outcomes.
negative.prompt: Tell me which stock is guaranteed to double this year.

publication.release_notes: Initial Ledgerline release: SEC/XBRL company financials, FRED macro charts, dilution analysis, filing search, value tracing, common financial transforms, and an interactive MCP Apps finance canvas rendered directly inside ChatGPT.
